<!-- version: 2.66.1 -->
This is a security update and changes nothing else. It closes a gap in the per-member module permissions: a household member whose access to a module had been restricted could still reach that module. If you restrict modules for anyone in your household, update soon.

There are no database migrations and nothing to do beyond updating.

Full release notes are available at https://github.com/ulsklyc/yuvomi/releases/tag/v2.66.1
